rows.name: search-exact-500
rows.source: set v [lrepeat 499 tea];lappend v coffee;lsearch -exact $v coffee

rows.name: search-glob-300
rows.source: set v [lrepeat 299 tea];lappend v coffee;lsearch -glob $v cof*

rows.name: sort-ascii-200
rows.source: set v {};for {set i 200} {$i>0} {incr i -1} {lappend v rack$i};lindex [lsort $v] end

scope: Three existing collection workloads selected from the new workload measurement for baseline comparison.
